content.html: MTBF = \(\frac{\text{Total testing time}}{\text{Total number of failures}}\)
400 memory sticks are each tested for 10 weeks. During this time 1100 failed. MTBF = \(\frac{15400 # 10}{1100}\) = 140 weeks
